rootHelp.stdout:
svger-cli - Custom SVG to Angular, React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and other component converter
Version: 4.0.8

Commands:
  build           Build all SVGs from source to output
  watch           Watch source folder and rebuild SVGs automatically
  generate        Convert a single SVG file into a component
  lock            Lock one or more SVG files
  unlock          Unlock one or more SVG files
  config          Manage svger-cli configuration
  plugins         List all registered plugins and their metrics
  optimize        Optimize SVG files without converting to components
  clean           Remove all generated SVG React components from output folder

Options:
  --help, -h      Show help
  --version, -v   Show version

build.stdout:
svger-cli build

Build all SVGs from source to output

Options:
  --framework <value>       Target framework (react|vue|svelte|angular|solid|preact|lit|vanilla)
  --typescript              Generate TypeScript components (default: true)
  --no-typescript           Generate JavaScript components
  --composition             Use Vue Composition API with <script setup>
  --standalone              Generate Angular standalone components
  --signals                 Use Angular signals for reactive state
  --optimize <value>        Optimization level: none, basic, balanced, aggressive, maximum (default: basic)
  --validate                Run visual diff validation after build
  --plugin <value>          Load plugin(s) by name or path (comma-separated for multiple)
  --list-plugins            List all registered plugins and exit

Global Options:
  --help, -h                Show help
